brief: When a viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, a pebble appears at the impact point, generating a visible ripple that expands outward across the water's surface. Unlike a typical fade, this ripple actively collapses, causing its outermost edges to rapidly shrink until the ripple structure completely vanishes. Following this rapid dissipation, a temporary, faint, solid ring is imprinted onto the surface at the original impact location, slowly fading away over time until it is gone.

statement: This sketch simulates the effect of a pebble dropped into water. When clicked anywhere on the canvas, a ripple expands outward from the impact point, growing rapidly before collapsing inward. As it dissipates, a faint ring remains at the original location and gradually fades away. The visual uses color and transparency to convey depth and motion within the constraints of a simple yet dynamic interaction.
